title: Refusal of blood: Jehovah's Witness
stem: Resus 2. Mr Leung, 40, has a bleeding duodenal ulcer. Hb 58 g/L, HR 118, BP 96/60. He is alert and clear. He is a Jehovah's Witness and says he does not want a blood transfusion. Discuss this with him.
notes:
Checked against the Hong Kong Medical Council Code of Professional Conduct (consent), Hospital Authority guidance on patients who refuse blood, GMC guidance on consent (2020), and the Association of Anaesthetists guidance on Jehovah's Witnesses (2018).

A competent adult may refuse any treatment, including life-saving blood, for any reason. Confirm capacity, give clear information about the risks (including death), explore which products he accepts (many Witnesses accept fractions such as albumin, clotting factors, cell salvage in continuity, EPO, tranexamic acid, IV iron — individual conscience), check for an advance directive / 'No Blood' card, offer a private conversation away from family or elders (to ensure the decision is voluntary), involve the Hospital Liaison Committee if he wishes, document, and maximise every blood-sparing measure: early endoscopy, tranexamic acid (in GI bleeding, HALT-IT showed no benefit, so not routine), PPI, IV iron, EPO, minimise sampling, early surgery or embolisation.

Children: parents cannot refuse life-saving treatment for a child; seek legal authority (in HK, via the court / Protection of Children and Juveniles Ordinance). Gillick competence (UK) — whether a young person under 16 can consent; refusal by a young person may still be overridden in their best interests. Your notes summarise Gillick and JW beliefs correctly.

steps.label: Talk to Mr Leung
steps.hint: Explain, check capacity, explore what he accepts, privacy, respect.

turns.line: I know I'm bleeding. But I won't accept blood. It's against my faith.
turns.lz: 我知我流緊血。但係我唔會接受輸血。咁樣違反我嘅信仰。

opts.t: Thank you for telling me — I'll respect your beliefs. Can I explain what's happening, so your decision is fully informed?
opts.tz: 多謝你話俾我知——我會尊重你嘅信仰。我可唔可以解釋吓而家嘅情況，等你喺清楚明白之下作決定？
opts.mark: Respects his beliefs and offers information

opts.rz: 唔該你唔好嘲笑我嘅信仰。

opts.t: Your blood count is very low, about half of normal. Without blood, if the bleeding continues you could have a heart attack, organ damage, or die. Can you tell me what you understand about the risk?
opts.tz: 你嘅血色素好低，得正常嘅一半左右。唔輸血嘅話，如果繼續出血，你可能會心臟病發、器官受損，甚至死亡。你可唔可以講吓你對呢個風險嘅理解？
opts.rz: 我明白我可能會死。我仍然拒絕輸全血。
opts.r: I understand I might die. I still refuse whole blood.
opts.mark: Explains the risk including death and checks understanding (capacity)

turns.line: I understand I might die. I still refuse whole blood.
turns.lz: 我明白我可能會死。我仍然拒絕輸全血。

opts.t: Are there things you would accept — for example clotting factors, albumin, or blood recycled during surgery? Do you carry an advance decision card?
opts.tz: 有冇啲嘢你係接受嘅——例如凝血因子、白蛋白，或者手術時回收再用嘅血？你有冇隨身帶住預設醫療指示卡？
opts.rz: 我接受白蛋白同凝血因子。呢張係我張卡。
opts.r: I accept albumin and clotting factors. Here's my card.
opts.mark: Explores acceptable products and any advance directive

turns.line: The elders from my congregation are outside.

opts.t: Would you like to talk with me alone for a minute first, so I know this is entirely your own decision?
opts.tz: 你想唔想先同我單獨傾一分鐘，等我確定呢個完全係你自己嘅決定？

opts.t: Let's get them in to decide.
opts.tz: 叫佢哋入嚟一齊決定啦。

steps.label: Blood-sparing plan
steps.hint: Endoscopy urgently, PPI, IV iron, minimise sampling, early surgery/IR, document.

opts.t: Urgent endoscopy; surgeon and IR aware early
IV PPI after endoscopy; IV iron; consider erythropoietin
Paediatric blood tubes to minimise sampling
Document his refusal, capacity, what he accepts, and the card; inform the team
Transfuse him once he loses consciousness
opts.r: A valid refusal made while capable remains binding when he loses capacity.

qs.q: Can a competent adult refuse life-saving blood?
A Jehovah's Witness parent refuses blood for their bleeding child. You…
wrong: Discharge the child to another hospital

qs.a: A child under 16 consenting to treatment
wrong: Adult capacity under the common law
Detention under the Mental Health Ordinance

qs.a: To check the refusal is voluntary
wrong: To persuade him away from his family
It is required by his church's hospital liaison committee
To avoid having to document it

qs.q: A product many Jehovah's Witnesses accept?
wrong: Packed red cells if washed and filtered
Whole blood from a directed donor

badge.name: Bloodless
badge.flavor: Respect a capable refusal. Then fight the bleed every other way.

cards.q: A capable adult's refusal of blood made in advance is…
options: Void once the patient is unconscious

cards.q: Primary components Jehovah's Witnesses usually refuse?
options: Red cells, white cells, platelets, plasma
Detention of adults under the MHO
Consent to organ donation after death

cards.q: Parents refuse life-saving blood for a child: the doctor…
options: Seek legal authority; treat in best interests
Always accepts the parents' refusal, as their right
Calls the church elders to decide
Waits for the child to improve

cards.why: HALT-IT showed no benefit from TXA in GI bleeding.

options: Capacity, information given, what is refused and accepted
The name of the church elder present
cards.why: Clear records protect patient and team.
